page.layout: Running head at top centre; one column of text, continuing from the previous page; a woodcut ornament in the middle of the page, below the text; catchword at the right below the ornament; a small signature mark at the lower left.

main_text.p: sica dicitur, sed si duntaxat quan-tum existit, & omnis affectio-nis & formæ expers, ad mathematicam spe-culationem spe-ctare vide-tur.

page.notes: The ornament is a decorative woodcut (a diamond-shaped floral motif) with no text. The small dots near "videtur" are printer's marks, not text. The first word "sica" is a fragment of "physica" and is kept as printed. "Exiftit" is transcribed as "existit" with the long s treated as a plain s. The catchword "INSTI-" is a large-type word at the right foot. The bottom signature "3 **" is uncertain. No page number is printed at the head or foot.
